information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BeCubedSpring2023#25513-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

This competition is in partnership with **Arizona Speedcubing, LLC**
